text: Name a music streaming platform (Spotify etc.)
answers: Amazon Music|6|Amazon Music Unlimited;Amazon Prime Music

facts.Spotify: Founded in Stockholm in 2006 by Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon.
facts.Apple Music: Launched in 2015, built partly on Beats Music, which Apple bought along with Beats in 2014.
facts.SoundCloud: Founded in 2007 and based in Berlin, it became a launch pad for rappers and bedroom producers.
facts.Tidal: Bought by Jay-Z in 2015 and relaunched with a line-up of star co-owners.
facts.Deezer: A French service, founded in Paris in 2007.
facts.Pandora: Grew out of the Music Genome Project, which describes each song by hundreds of musical traits.
facts.Napster: Began in 1999 as a file-sharing service, was shut down after music-industry lawsuits, then came back as a legal one.
facts.Winamp: Remembered for the start-up clip “Winamp, it really whips the llama’s ass”.
